title: Lyme Disease Biobank: 10 years of 3 month follow-up visits from 2014 to 2023
license: CC BY, stated on PDF page 1
limits: Selected returning participants: 253 of 466 cases; no outcome observed for nonreturners
Only Long Island NY and Central Wisconsin represented
Participants included confirmed, probable, suspected and symptomatic-no-lesion groups; some may not have early Lyme
Symptoms around three months are not a six-month PTLDS or persistent-infection diagnosis
Symptom causes may be unrelated to Lyme
No economic valuations, prices or patient payment amounts were reported
Different classification definitions from Hook study
Observational treatment patterns do not establish treatment effectiveness or justify medication recommendations
provenance: Only published paper facts are stored here; no workbook rows, IDs, comments or private aggregate analyses are copied.
